svg.title: Horticulturist — Man
svg.desc: A fictional man working as horticulturist, wearing an apron. Visible work cue: A small potted seedling has two distinct leaves beside a separate pointed hand trowel. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Appearance: a shaved head, an oval face.
